SEASON

When this trip makes sense.

A reliable month-by-month fishing window has not been established from the inspected material for this particular trip. Ask the local operator or fisheries service to confirm the target, access and conditions for your dates before making non-refundable arrangements.

The decision that shapes this trip

Choose the actual lake and access route with a local source before treating the group of lakes as one fishery. Ask about the target, walking demands and useful tackle. Keep the pack compact and separate a scenic hike from confirmation of a fishable location.

Protect the hiking plan first

Confirm that the particular lake and access route suit the intended fishing visit. Keep the fishing equipment compact enough that it does not displace navigation, layers, water and emergency essentials. Bank fishing does not automatically require waders.

LICENCE & PERMITS

Fishing licence for Andorra

Visitors need an Andorran fishing licence. A managed fishing area also requires its own acotat permit, including areas where you must release the catch.

  • 1 dayEUR 40
  • 3 daysEUR 70
  • 1 dayEUR 20
  • 3 daysEUR 30
Official rules ↗

Permits for this trip

  • Tristaina catch-and-release acotat permit ↗ · EUR 2
    Anglers who fish Estany Primer de Tristaina. Buy the no-kill acotat permit through an authorized Andorra licence seller.
  • Tristaina intensive acotat permit ↗ · EUR 9
    Anglers who fish the separate intensive Tristaina area. Buy the intensive-area permit for the selected date.

Rules for this water

  • Estany Primer is catch-and-release; use a single barbless artificial hook and a landing net.
  • The 2026 Tristaina lake season runs June 6–November 1; fish only in daylight.
  • Check the official rules for Tristaina lakes / Ordino, including water exceptions and current closures official regulations ↗
